jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 건축인허가 대지위치 lane `building-permit-site-location` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0402): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_permit_site_location already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows key bucket by key bucket and append to main only the changed site rows and a removal marker per vanished one (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.

first_run.estimated_from: computed, about 2.5x the nearest larger measured neighbours on the same template unit (root ADR-0386): silver_refresh_building_permit_basis_outline 357 s for a 438 MB release, _parking 251 s for 59 MB, _demolition_loss 161 s for 15 MB; this lane's newest release is about 231 MB in the Bronze ledger (2026-11-09)

assets.title: 건축인허가 대지위치
assets.description: 허가나 동이 선 필지마다 한 행: 대표 대지 여부, 지번, 지목, 주·부속 동 구분. 허가 하나가 여러 필지에 걸친 것을 말한다(기본개요는 대표 지번 하나뿐이다). 관리허가대장관리번호·관리동별개요관리번호로 기본개요·동별개요에 붙는다. 원문 20칸 보존. 필지 by-PNU 종류 parcel-building-permits 가 행의 PNU 로 필지 문서의 목록 하나로 싣는다(루트 ADR-0402, ADR-0462).

dependencies.description: 건축인허가 대지위치(mart_kcy_16) 20칸을 관리대지위치관리번호 마다 바뀐 대지 행만 append-only Silver 로 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0402).
dependencies.pnu_resolution: pnu composed at Silver by the Rust hub/VWorld export (export-*-silver-handoff, standard_pnu_from_hub_register_codes / ADR-0145) from 시군구 column 5 and 법정동 column 9, not the 행정동 column 8; HUB 대지구분 empty or 2 (블록) composes none (FP-ADR-0023); a permit's site often names a parcel since merged or split, which the consumer carries to the current pnu through the place-identity resolver and views.changed_codes (ADR-0288, ADR-0329, ADR-0402)
